title: Distributed Caching
subtitle: Multi-instance Redis, consistent hashing, and Redis Cluster

content.text: A single Redis instance may not be enough. Use Redis Cluster or a client-side consistent hash to distribute keys across multiple instances.
Redis Cluster automatically shards data across up to 1000 nodes using 16384 hash slots.

questions.question: How many hash slots does Redis Cluster use?
questions.explanation: Redis Cluster uses 16384 hash slots distributed across shards.

faq.q: Can I use pipelining with Redis Cluster?
faq.a: Yes, but all keys in a pipeline must map to the same hash slot. Use hash tags {user:1} to force co-location.
